description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for profiles in an ASP.NET Core application, including a request object, validator, and handler for retrieving profile details based on username.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object containing a username to query profile details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query by reading the profile using the injected profileReader.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming query and retrieves profile data asynchronously.
